text:
Anya: observed a regression on canary: streaming p95 jumped ~45ms after yesterday's continuous-batching tweak. looks correlated with KV eviction churn.
Raj: can you paste the perf trace / which config changed?
Anya: earlier roll updated batch_token_budget from 256->384 and reduced kv_warmup_ms from 120->60.
perf-bot: canary/region-us-west2: stream_latency_p95 +45ms, kv_evictions/sec x2. Samples attached to trace id sha256:7f3...
Lorenzo: hmm increasing token budget can make batches wait longer which increases chance of KV cache miss if we evict earlier. when batches coalesce we sometimes hit a kernel-size boundary and fall back to the slow path.
Ciaran: are we seeing kernel fallback logs? (kernel_fallback=true)
perf-bot: yes, 18% of requests in the window hit fallback to reference kernel; before change it was 3%.
Raj: that explains latency. fallback happens when combined seq_len > small-kernel max_seq (128) after concatenation?
Lorenzo: right. continuous batching merges queued requests; if budget high we merge more, pushing the aggregate length into a kernel that isn't optimized -> fallback.
Anya: also noticed partial-decode scheduling delayed flushes: partial decode backpressure kept KV warmup from firing, so we hit cold KV later in the decode.
Ciaran: can we force early flushes for streaming responses when kernel_fallback risk > threshold? e.g. if predicted merged_seq > 120, do an early flush of the oldest request.
Lorenzo: proposal: add a pre-merge check that computes merged_seq_estimate and if > small_kernel_limit then split per-request so small-kernel stays in fast path. also reduce kv_warmup_ms back to 120 for canary.
Anya: quick config to trial on canary:
```\nbatch_token_budget: 300\nsmall_kernel_limit: 128\nkv_warmup_ms: 120\npartial_decode_window_ms: 60\npremerge_seq_threshold: 120\n```
Raj: +1 to premerge check. Another idea: make partial-decode scheduling favor emitting first token earlier (flush cadence tweak) when a request is solo in batch for >X ms.
Ciaran: will add a lightweight admission rule: if request_count==1 and predicted_tokens>80, do partial-send after 20ms to avoid long waiting single large requests.
perf-bot: will instrument kernel_fallback_rate, avg_kv_miss_latency, stream_emit_delay.
Anya: I'll roll the premerge + kv_warmup bump to canary now. tagging @Lorenzo for kernel heuristic follow-ups.
deploy-bot: started rollout to canary (canary-id: rwd-can-3141). expected 10m ramp.
Lorenzo: after canary collects ~1h of traffic let's reconvene with profiles. If fallback drops to <5% and p95 recovers we can promote and iterate on making premerge heuristic adaptive.
Raj: also add an E2E microbench: synthetic mix with many mid-size streams to stress the merge boundary.
Anya: noted. adding test to perf-suite. thanks team :thumbsup:
